issues.reason: A modifier genus is exposed only for a modifier predicable of the referent, and 'first-year' is a noun-phrase / rank modifier that fails that test (*'the apprentice is first-year') — exactly the 'assistant secretary' case that keeps the head genus alone — and the atom is false besides, since a first-year apprentice is not a kind of first_year.

new_gaps: A fused compound whose MODIFIER is itself multi-word ('first-year', 'long-term') has no stated decomposition target: 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas' presumes a single-word modifier, so in the cases where the predication test DOES pass (a predicable hyphenated adjective) the rule names no well-formed genus to emit.
defect_summary: The compliant parse keeps the head genus alone — (Inheritance first_year_apprentice apprentice) beside (Member coraline_ash first_year_apprentice) and the Name fact — with no modifier genus emitted at all.
notes: The fusion itself is right: a rank/role title classifying the head into a genuine subtype, like senior_contractor. Member for the individual and Inheritance for the kind-to-kind link are both correct, as are the definitional truth values.
